routeGroups.role: Command-driven incremental edits and full automatic editing.

short.behavior: Uses short pacing, vertical-safe layouts, burned-caption defaults, and the shared isolated-candidate QC path.
blockers: Short graphics repairs outside caption shards still cross the monolithic compatibility compositor.
The bounded P2 structured repair lifecycle is released, but free-form creator-footage repair, general populated-layer picture repair, and connected Palmier readback remain unqualified.

longform.behavior: Uses long-form planning, front-loaded pacing, chapters/SRT policy, and retained graphics/audio fast paths before isolated-candidate QC.
blockers: The retained fast paths are not a qualified 10-14 minute incremental render graph or 90-minute SLA.
The bounded P2 structured repair lifecycle is released, but free-form creator-footage repair, general populated-layer picture repair, and connected Palmier readback remain unqualified.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Plan-only requests are surgical; caption shards and governed scene units can be local. Other changed plan lanes may rebuild the compatibility base or whole composite.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Auto Edit defaults to the Palmier-hybrid compatibility workflow; ai-edit may select a managed Palmier path. Native fidelity and full hybrid export remain separately gated.

routeGroups.role: Create an editor-ready base and assemble the approved final MP4.

short.behavior: Renders short-safe captions/layout and reuses the base only when compatibility fingerprints permit.
blockers: Graphics-only short repairs can still re-enter a monolithic graphics composite.

longform.behavior: Supports retained graphics-only and audio-only paths over the editor-ready base.
blockers: Whole-cut video fingerprints and incomplete cross-lane dependencies prevent a fully qualified dirty graph.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Caption shards and selected graphics/audio lanes reuse stable media; cut, zoom, reframe, or stale dependencies rebuild the base.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: These routes author the exact MP4 authority. Palmier publication is a separate delivery action.

routeGroups.role: Persist operator intent, validate plans, and expose the current plan.

short.behavior: Accepts canonical story form short independently from canvas and validates short-specific plan rules.

longform.behavior: Accepts canonical story form longform independently from canvas and validates long-form-specific plan rules.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: These routes mutate or validate JSON authority only; they do not render media.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Plan authority does not itself claim a Palmier timeline mutation.

routeGroups.role: Read-only composition, frame, transcript, and waveform inspection.

short.behavior: Reads the selected project's exact source/derived evidence without choosing short policy.

longform.behavior: Reads the selected project's exact source/derived evidence without choosing long-form policy.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Read-only inspection does not invalidate or render timeline nodes.

routeGroups.role: Select, snapshot, admit, and inventory source media, including guarded exact-media transcript-authority promotion.

short.behavior: Admits immutable source media before short-form planning and can promote a timing-valid transcript only from an exact-media donor.

longform.behavior: Admits immutable source media before long-form planning and can promote a timing-valid transcript only from an exact-media donor.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: A source-set change invalidates dependent compilation/render authority in either form.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Ingress does not select Palmier as timeline authority.

routeGroups.role: List projects and report durable producer status.

short.behavior: Reports the stored short project state without changing it.

longform.behavior: Reports the stored long-form project state without changing it.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Status reads do not invalidate media.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Palmier status is reported only from its explicit state records.

routeGroups.role: Admit a reference, study its mechanics, and retain operator strategy.

short.behavior: Can study a short reference and feed the current planning prompts.
blockers: Verified mimic on unseen footage is not P6-qualified.

longform.behavior: Can study a long-form reference and feed the current planning prompts.
blockers: Verified mimic on unseen footage is not P6-qualified.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: A changed reference profile invalidates planning/scene dependencies, not unrelated admitted source bytes.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Reference study supplies intent; it does not itself mutate Palmier.

routeGroups.role: Open, inspect, build, QC, push, and reconcile Palmier delivery state.

short.behavior: Supports a local production-callable mastered-stereo route, exact hidden-master path, strict editable-parity contract, one-scene replacement executor, durable mutation journal, and immutable pre-mutation crash snapshots.
blockers: Connected representative short export/readback, passing mastered-stereo audio-route authority, exact-master mutation, disconnect recovery, and manual-edit preservation are not qualified; editable stems lack stable role/output-bus readback.

longform.behavior: Supports the same local mastered-stereo and delivery prerequisites for long-form candidates, including exact full-stream parity and fail-closed reconciliation.
blockers: Connected representative long-form export/readback, paging, bounded timeout, passing mastered-stereo audio-route authority, disconnect recovery, and manual-edit preservation are not qualified; editable stems lack stable role/output-bus readback.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Only a proved Palmier lane update may replace its bound clips; otherwise delivery falls back to a baked exact master.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Palmier calls are confined to this delivery family or explicitly selected Palmier-hybrid orchestration.

routeGroups.role: Fence and stop the current Auto Edit worker.

short.behavior: Stops a short-form worker at the same durable boundaries.

longform.behavior: Stops a long-form worker at the same durable boundaries.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Stopping preserves completed checkpoints and prevents stale worker publication.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Stop does not start a new Palmier mutation.

routeGroups.role: Run the legacy speech-cleanup compatibility operation.

short.behavior: Cleans selected short-form speech through the legacy route.
blockers: This route is not the first-class non-ripple word-repair approval workflow.

longform.behavior: Cleans selected long-form speech through the legacy route.
blockers: This route is not the first-class non-ripple word-repair approval workflow.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Legacy cleanup follows its own media boundary; phrase repair must use cut.restoreSpeech.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: No first-class sample-exact native Palmier L/J guarantee is claimed.

routeGroups.role: Create or replay one governed private scene-unit review repair.

short.behavior: Renders only the named governed scene unit into a private review fragment while preserving the approved base and every unrelated scene.
blockers: Legacy short graphics outside governed scene packages still use the broader compatibility compositor.

longform.behavior: The retained 14-minute, 50-scene proof renders one dirty unit, reuses the other unit and 49 scenes, and never re-encodes the full base or full duration.
blockers: This private review route is not general final-master dirty-window assembly or a connected editor replacement.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Only the named scene/unit package may render; exact project fanout preserves unrelated scenes and the approved base, and the route never publishes active output.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: The route creates private local review media only; connected Palmier replacement remains separately gated.

routeGroups.role: Inspect/open a parent-bound HyperFrames projection or explicitly preview/apply supported Studio edits to a draft, never approve delivery.

short.behavior: Provides guarded status/open/reuse for short-form graphics timing and copy review.
blockers: Short-form real-player qualification, safe sync, audiovisual comparison and spatial preview/export parity remain open.

longform.behavior: A 12-second synthetic 1080p project plays in the actual embedded Studio UI; the projection is not an approved final.
blockers: Creator-footage long-form qualification, safe sync, source-mutation regression and final render parity remain open.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Reuses a current projection without overwriting pending edits; draft import requires exact original/current/proposal authority and the project lease. It cannot render or replace a final master.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: No Palmier launch or delivery adapter is needed for this review surface; legacy project migration remains explicitly guarded.

routeGroups.role: Read the exact paused cut-review descriptor and stream its receipt-bound private media without accepting or rendering anything.

short.behavior: Private cut-only preview readback requires the exact waiting job, review request, source-set receipt and rendered media identity.
blockers: Actual short-form review UI, explicit acceptance/continuation and preview/final audio parity remain open.

longform.behavior: Same private preview contract; range streaming hashes and serves one checked file descriptor and never accepts a caller-selected media path.
blockers: Creator-footage long-form playback, approval/brief handoff, complete audiovisual comparison and measured throughput remain open.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Read-only exact cut artifact, not graphics, final crop, grade, mix or delivery approval. Earlier pointerless checkpoints cannot be accepted.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Explicit MP4 cut-first jobs only; no Palmier operation is invoked.

routeGroups.role: Explicit exact-preview human acceptance, historical accepted-cut readback and separately requested continuation retry.

short.behavior: Requires four explicit human attestations, exact paused preview identities and fresh admitted source-byte verification; records an immutable cut-only decision before worker handoff.
blockers: Actual short-form human acceptance UI qualification, changed post-cut treatment handoff and full audiovisual quality comparison remain open.

longform.behavior: The same exact-v1 decision continues the previously bound brief; replay cannot spawn another worker and pending continuation requires explicit retry.
blockers: Creator-footage long-form audition and human review, intro checkpoint, new treatment authority and end-to-end throughput remain unproved.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Acceptance is scoped only to the unchanged cut. It cannot change the brief, regenerate the story, bypass final QC, or turn a worker completion into delivery approval.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Explicit MP4 cut-first jobs only; no legacy delivery-policy migration.

routeGroups.role: Inspect launch eligibility or explicitly request one detached, journal-bound opening controller; never infer liveness or retry authority from a recorded request.

short.behavior: Local GET reads launch metadata; explicit POST requires the accepted cut, clean treatment readiness, exact submission, project lease and original remaining generation budget. Unsupported requested lanes are refused rather than omitted.
blockers: Representative short-form creator-footage, audiovisual quality and end-to-end latency qualification remain open; public source-color V2 media execution remains explicitly fenced.

longform.behavior: The same one-shot controller can execute the admitted opening and transition-context profile, reconcile owned resources, requalify and select private review media. A recorded launch is not proof of a running worker; uncertain or failed launches cannot automatically restart.
blockers: Retained synthetic long-form mechanics do not qualify creator footage, complete-body generation, delivery or the two-hour target; public source-color V2 media execution remains explicitly fenced.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Bound to the exact existing cut, treatment and journal; the detached handoff carries the original clock. Launch does not itself approve the opening, generate the full body or approve delivery.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: Private guided MP4 opening only; no Palmier mutation or delivery-policy migration.

routeGroups.role: Observe current opening ownership and selected evidence, or stream an exact selected private core/review artifact without generation or approval.

short.behavior: Local read-only status preserves unresolved-claim priority and reports last-qualified selection, not fresh source requalification. Playback requires exact current selection/range/media hashes and hashes the entire selected artifact through the same descriptor it serves.
blockers: Representative short-form playback, word-timed visual placement and creator audiovisual review remain unqualified; metadata and streaming tests are not subjective quality approval.

longform.behavior: The same exact private core/context readback rejects stale or unbound media without accepting an arbitrary path. Status and seeks do not launch generation, clear ownership, renew the original generation budget or approve anything.
blockers: Creator-footage long-form opening/body continuity, listening and final-composite comparison remain open; retained synthetic playback does not qualify complete-output quality or throughput.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Read-only evidence and selected-media access. Current unresolved ownership blocks selection; cheap status does not substitute for the strong read-only child required at selection and approval.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: No Palmier operation; the returned private MP4 range is not delivery authority.

routeGroups.role: Record an explicit local human opening-only decision after exact-selection requalification, preserving separate body and delivery gates.

short.behavior: A bounded same-origin submission must contain all explicit human attestations and exact selected identities. Under the project lease, current source/pipeline/output requalification precedes the immutable opening-only approval; no render is launched.
blockers: Actual creator short-form human review and audiovisual qualification remain open; synthetic attestations and automated readback do not constitute human acceptance or delivery approval.

longform.behavior: The same guarded approval binds the actual current selection and its versioned retained proof. Approval uses a separate bounded read-only allowance, not a renewed generation budget, and always leaves bodyGenerated and deliveryApproved false.
blockers: Creator-footage long-form listening, opening-to-body continuity and full-output qualification remain open; source-color proof handling does not release the fenced native execution workflow.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: Only an exact reviewed opening may be approved. This endpoint cannot change the cut or treatment, generate the body, release unresolved ownership, or turn worker completion into human approval.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: No Palmier mutation or delivery approval; those remain separate explicit workflows.

routeGroups.role: Read bounded source context or explicitly run an owned, private source-color diagnostic and inspect its project-bound status.

short.behavior: Samples retained source/lighting groups under explicit unknown-by-default profile and transform history; no plan or grade is applied.
blockers: Synthetic Color UI/API lifecycle has been exercised; creator footage, grading schema, operator image comparison and browser/final color parity remain unqualified.

longform.behavior: Private diagnostics cover late retained intervals within a declared sample budget; omissions and intentional lighting remain visible.
blockers: Whole-source hashing cost on representative long-form media, operator recovery from uncertain cleanup and meaningful audiovisual color comparison remain unproved.

routeGroups.incrementalBoundary: New private evidence only, exact plan/manifest parents and admitted source bytes. Unreviewed luma screening is not applicable to a plan, not a grade, and never delivery approval.
routeGroups.palmierBoundary: No Palmier operation or delivery-policy change; the existing project mutation boundary remains required.

short.behavior: Cut-first authoring uses short pacing, safe-zone, split-layout, and burned-caption policy.
blockers: The complete short build still uses compatibility render boundaries.

longform.behavior: Cut-first authoring uses long-form planning, pacing envelopes, SRT/chapters, and retained lane fast paths.
blockers: A complete 10-14 minute build is not yet qualified against the 90-minute target.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Initial build may render the full base; subsequent changes follow the lane-specific rows below.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Exact MP4 is canonical unless an explicit Palmier delivery workflow proves and promotes its own candidate.

short.behavior: Plan mutation is surgical, but non-caption visual changes may still invoke the broader short compositor.
blockers: Short graphics repair is not universally one-unit dirty rendering.

longform.behavior: Plan mutation is surgical and retained graphics/audio paths can avoid rebuilding the base.
blockers: Cross-lane fingerprints are not yet a complete semantic render graph.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Unchanged plan fields must stay byte-identical; media reuse is permitted only where the current fingerprints/graph prove it.
workflows.palmierBoundary: An incremental Sniper edit does not silently mutate a human-owned Palmier head.

short.behavior: The bounded P2 contract has exact analysis, private candidate preparation, independent alignment evidence, governed review/approval/promotion, and unchanged-outside-window proof.
blockers: Free-form creator requests, creator-speech/operator-audition qualification, general picture repair with populated treatment lanes, and connected Palmier readback remain release gates.

longform.behavior: The bounded P2 contract also covers all released rates, normalized VFR, multi-source fixtures, caption refit, L/J projection, and exact non-ripple preservation.
blockers: Free-form creator requests, creator-speech/operator-audition qualification, general layered dirty-window recomposition, native sample-exact Palmier L/J, and connected long-form readback remain release gates.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Only the selected dirty audio/picture window may change; promotion requires unchanged outside-window picture/mapping and candidate-bound QC.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Unselected delivery is exact local-only; selected native L/J remains unqualified and may require a baked exact master.

short.behavior: Arbitrary phrase/range karaoke compiles to short-safe bounded alpha shards.

longform.behavior: Arbitrary phrase/range karaoke compiles to long-form bounded alpha shards plus shared SRT/chapter authority.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: A caption-only edit rebuilds affected alpha shards and caption preview nodes while preserving the caption-free base and audio.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Palmier caption disposition is compiled from the same word/timeline authority; native delivery stays subject to its delivery gate.

short.behavior: Direct Codex/Claude CLI authoring supports project scenes, assets, 9:16/other released aspects, and all measured rates.

longform.behavior: Direct Codex/Claude CLI authoring supports project scenes, assets, 16:9/other released aspects, and all measured rates.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Scene units are independently cacheable; right-copy repair renders one unit and a timing move reuses scene media.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Released projection is baked-regenerable with exact media bindings; native After Effects-style keyframe parity is not claimed.

short.behavior: Governed scene-package copy repair can render one unit, while legacy catalog graphics still use the broader short graphics path.
blockers: The legacy short graphics lane is not universally unit-dirty.

longform.behavior: Governed scene-package copy repair renders one unit and the retained long-form graphics path can reuse the base.
blockers: General final-master dirty-window assembly and connected one-clip replacement remain unqualified.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Project-scene units are local; legacy graphics reuse follows current fingerprint authority.
workflows.palmierBoundary: A changed scene unit replaces its baked-regenerable clip only after exact binding/readback.

short.behavior: Face/split primitives do not constitute released continuous tracking.
blockers: No-face, multi-face, occlusion, screen-share, boundary, motion, canvas/FPS, and override fixtures are incomplete.

longform.behavior: reframe.track remains reserved and accepts only false.
blockers: No-face, multi-face, occlusion, screen-share, boundary, motion, canvas/FPS, and override fixtures are incomplete.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: No continuous-tracking node may be scheduled.
workflows.palmierBoundary: No native or baked continuous-reframe claim is released.

short.behavior: The primitive exists but needsPip is rejected and no production planner/renderer route wires it.
blockers: Animated PIP fixture and production wiring gates are incomplete.

longform.behavior: The primitive exists but needsPip is rejected and no production planner/renderer route wires it.
blockers: Animated PIP fixture and production wiring gates are incomplete.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: No animated-PIP node may be scheduled.
workflows.palmierBoundary: No native or baked animated-PIP claim is released.

short.behavior: A local production-callable mastered-stereo route plus exact-master, editable-parity, scene-replacement, durable mutation-journal, and crash-snapshot prerequisites exist, but connected editable short parity is not qualified.
blockers: Connected short export with complete readback, a passing mastered-stereo audio-route authority, exact-master mutation, one-scene replacement, disconnect recovery, and manual-edit preservation remains; editable stems lack stable role/output-bus readback.

longform.behavior: A local production-callable mastered-stereo route plus exact-master, editable-parity, scene-replacement, durable mutation-journal, and crash-snapshot prerequisites exist, but connected editable long-form parity is not qualified.
blockers: Connected long-form export with paged complete readback, bounded timeout, a passing mastered-stereo audio-route authority, exact-master mutation, one-scene replacement, disconnect recovery, and manual-edit preservation remains; editable stems lack stable role/output-bus readback.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Baked exact masters remain the fallback until each editable lane proves local replacement.
workflows.palmierBoundary: P5 is the release gate for complete hybrid delivery.

short.behavior: Reference study can inform current short planning, but objective verified mimic is not released.
blockers: Three-pack objective tolerance, rights, reviewer-adjudication, and unseen-footage gates remain.

longform.behavior: Reference study can inform current long-form planning, but objective verified mimic is not released.
blockers: Three-pack objective tolerance, rights, reviewer-adjudication, and unseen-footage gates remain.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: A verified pack would invalidate only mechanics it binds; current prompt guidance does not prove that closure.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Reference mechanics do not authorize copying identity assets or native Palmier parity.

short.behavior: A retained 45-second current-path cold/warm baseline exists.
blockers: The baseline is not a qualified optimized-graph latency SLA.

longform.behavior: A retained LF-14 current-path cold/warm baseline exists and is faster than 90 minutes on the measured fixture.
blockers: The 90-minute target is not qualified on complete creator projects or an untouched cohort.

workflows.incrementalBoundary: Baseline traces measure the current path; they do not prove every incremental edit stays local.
workflows.palmierBoundary: Performance qualification includes exact MP4; complete hybrid Palmier timing is a later cohort.
